title: Perfect VFX Brand Kit
description: Per-creator persistent brand file. Lives at Documents/Perfect VFX/brand-kit.json. If present, Perfect VFX asks ZERO style questions. If missing, the skill runs the one-time onboarding interview, writes this file, and never asks again. Every field except theme is optional; anything absent falls back to the chosen theme's defaults.

name.description: Creator or channel display name, available to graphics that mention the brand

theme.description: The material + motion + layout system. Colors and fonts below only reskin it. simple-claude is the default when the user skips onboarding.

colors.description: Optional overrides of the theme's default palette.

fonts.description: Optional overrides of the theme's default type stack. Any Google Fonts family works by name (fetched automatically at render time, case insensitive). Non-Google fonts must be INSTALLED on the rendering machine and referenced by name (source local) with a Google fallback; a bare file path is not loaded by the renderer.

source.description: google = fetched by family name (any Google Fonts family); local = installed on this machine (e.g. Adobe CC fonts), referenced by name with a fallback; file = DEPRECATED, treated as local (install the font file on the machine first)

path.description: Legacy field for source = file; the renderer does not load font files from paths, install the font instead

fallback.description: Google Fonts family used when a local font is unavailable

vibeNotes.description: Free-text vibe words from onboarding. Flavors CONCEPT_GRAPHIC art direction ONLY. Never changes layout, motion timing, or which moves fire; those are theme + Director territory.
